FAILURE MODE: none -- each extra unroll step suppresses more sparse-view streaks. HYPOTHESIS KNOB: vn_T 4 -> 5 (continue the winning depth direction; one more data+regularizer GD step). All else = iter-5 (filters=16, kernel=9, n_bumps=31, x_range=2.0, lr=9.6e-4, batch=2, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, train_n=400). max_train_s=1650 guards the wall under the 1800s kill. batch_size=2 (512px OOM guard).
